patch.value: Parsing is pinned to a typescript@5 alias devDependency because TypeScript 7 removed the stable compiler API: createSourceFile and forEachChild are absent at runtime while still type-checking, and the unstable replacements are either a raw lexer the consumer must drive through template and regex rescanning, or a project API needing a live native language-server session.
Docstring coverage gate: a parser-backed, self-scanning mandatory check

Fail the build when any documented-surface declaration lacks a real docstring. The gate parses each file into a syntax tree rather than scanning text, so a JSDoc inside a string literal or above a commented-out declaration cannot satisfy it, and it rejects a comment that merely restates the identifier. It walks its roots instead of reading a file list, so a new file is covered the moment it exists, and it fails rather than passing when a root is missing or empty.

npm run docstring exits 0 across src and scripts; exits 1 naming file:line:symbol for a missing, too-short, or name-restating docstring; a declaration inside a string or a comment is never counted; a missing or empty root fails; the gate passes on its own source
